description: Spec 012 (phase 4, SRD Annex C, decision 28): tracker T2, the pure recurrent tracker with a Gaussian head, trained from scratch on generator 0.5.0 data (seed 211, 20–60 min windows, 0–3 course changes and an occasional speed change). Both trackers share this dataset and are judged on the same rows at G5 on fresh seed 212 (400,000; its 40,000-scenario test split, generated alone), against the frozen reference the decision record names. The evaluation job only commits the model; the validation diagnostic and G5 are scored with tma-track and tma-g5.
